text:
ella: quick heads-up — planning a toggle sweep tomorrow 09:00-12:00 PST for a few runtime kernel/opt flags: flash_attn, speculative_decoding, and kv_cache eviction tweaks. want to coordinate owners, canary audiences, and rollback criteria. recommended guardrails: p50 latency regresses > 100ms OR error-rate increase > 0.8% -> rollback. any objections?
sam: I can own flash_attn. plan: 1% static canary (canary-a), monitor p50/p95, cpu/gpu % and token throughput for 30m, then 10% (canary-b) for 1h, then 50% if clean. will post the exact flip commands. :thumbsup:
jia: i'll take speculative_decoding. note: specdec has shown higher mem pressure on long seqs (>2048) in my last run. will gate with a header so only short-seq requests get it during canary. also will add a forced-fallback check for >2x memory alloc.
matt: i'll handle kv_cache eviction tuning. current idea: increase min_cache_ttl to 10s and reduce aggressive-evict threshold from 0.6 -> 0.8 for the canary. goal is to avoid thrash when flash_attn ramps.
nisha: quick Q — ordering wise, should we enable kv changes before flash_attn to avoid cache churn? or do flash_attn first?
sam: +1 to kv first. if flash_attn rolls with a small cache TTL it might thrash evictions and spike latency.
ella: agreed — kv_cache owners flip first, then flash_attn, then specdec. we'll stagger by 30m windows between each phase.
ella: rollout plan sketch: 
```yaml
- phase: kv_cache_canary
  owner: matt
  audience: canary-kv-1 (2%)
  run_for: 30m
  metrics: [p50_latency, errors, eviction_rate]
  rollback_if: p50_delta>100ms or errors>0.8%
- phase: flash_attn_canary
  owner: sam
  audience: canary-fa-1 (2%)
  run_for: 30m
  metrics: [p50_latency, gpu_util, token_throughput]
- phase: specdec_canary
  owner: jia
  audience: canary-sd-1 (2%)
  run_for: 30m
```
ella: please paste your exact audience names and any script/commands you'll run. i'll coordinate the windows and update the runbook.
sam: commands i'll use (ops-approved):
```bash
# set flag for audience canary-fa-1
./flagctl set runtime.flags.flash_attn true --audience canary-fa-1 --note "canary sweep 1729990000"
# check state
./flagctl get runtime.flags.flash_attn --audience canary-fa-1
```
jia: for specdec i'll use a header-based gate: `x-rd-specdec: canary-sd-1` so only routed test traffic gets it. will also enable heap logging for 15m after flip.
matt: kv commands: `./flagctl set runtime.flags.kv_min_ttl 10 --audience canary-kv-1` and `./flagctl set runtime.flags.kv_evict_threshold 0.8 --audience canary-kv-1`
ellA: small ask — please post PRs/CR links so QE can attach smoke tests. i'll block 60m on my calendar to watch metrics during the first flips.
sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842 (flash_attn gating + metrics). @matt @jia can you CR?
matt: review in progress, pinged in PR.
jia: LGTM on specdec code, left one comment about the header parsing.
deploy-bot: scheduled toggle window for kv_cache_canary at 2026-03-19T16:00:00Z. will post updates when each phase flips.
ella: rollback criteria reminder: immediate rollback if 3 consecutive 1m buckets exceed thresholds OR if any user-facing error spikes (>=1% of requests). also if SLO alerts hit p50>200ms auto-notify #oncall.
nisha: thanks — i'll notify product and support about the plan and expected small blips.
sam: will set dashboards: p50/p95, gpu%/cpu%, errors, token_throughput, kv_evictions. posting links after setup.
ella: perfect. final checklist: PRs merged, audits green, owners listed (matt, sam, jia), windows scheduled, runbook updated. i'll post the final window and the playbook link in this thread ~1h before start.
sam: ack.
matt: ack.
jia: ack.
deploy-bot: kv_canary flipped to canary-kv-1 (2%) on 3 hosts — timestamp 1729995400. monitoring hooks enabled.
